title: The Brass Celestial Observatory
summary: An interactive Three.js copper-domed observatory housing a glass-topped clockwork orrery with 210 toothed wheels, worm drives, and chains.
description: An interactive Three.js / WebGL2 observatory and 30-second film. Forty copper leaves retract along the dome ribs above a mahogany library, revealing a glass-topped clockwork movement with 210 toothed wheels, eight worm drives, and two moving chains driving the armillary Sun and planetary arms.
